documentSetsGuidePurpose: A document set is a named snapshot of the documents currently open. Restore it later in the saved order when switching between projects or tasks.
documentSetsGuideStep1: Open the documents needed for the task, enter a name below, then choose Save current documents.
documentSetsGuideStep2: When returning, use Preview restore to review pending and already-open counts, then choose Restore.
documentSetsGuideStep3: Export and import document sets for backup or migration. Saving with the same name updates the existing set.
documentSetsGuideNote: Note: document sets store stable root-document references only. They do not save cursor positions, transient tabs, or document content. Deleted or unavailable documents are marked missing before restore.
